title: Never define a component inside another

slides.say: Components can render other components. But never define one component inside another.

slides.text: Very slow, and it causes bugs.
slides.say: Here Profile is defined inside Gallery. The docs say this is very slow and causes bugs.

slides.text: Each render creates a different Profile function, so React resets all state below it.
slides.say: Why? Every render of Gallery creates a different Profile function. React sees a different component in the same spot and resets its state. Typed text just vanishes.
The fix: declare every component at the top level. If the child needs data from the parent, pass it as props.
Takeaway: define components at the top level, and pass data down with props.
